title: Where does push add an item?

story.question: How does push change an array?
story.takeaway: push appends to the same array; length increases by the number of added items.

intro.title:
Add one item.
What changes?
intro.vo: The array items contains A and B. When push adds C, what changes on this screen?
intro.label: One array · linked views

scenes.title: C joins the end.
scenes.vo: Push adds C to the end of the array items. Once C arrives, the array has three items and length changes from two to three.

scenes.title: One shared state.
scenes.vo: The list and the length tile both describe the array items. Three elements here correspond to the three over there. These are two views of the same array.

scenes.title:
Add D.
Same rule.
scenes.vo: Keep the array we just changed and use push to add D at the end. It still starts with A, B, C; now D is included and length is four.

outro.title:
Append to the end.
Change this array.
outro.vo: For this JavaScript array, push appends to the array we already have. The length tile simply reflects the new item count; it is not a second array.
outro.label: Array.push()
